scientific_integrity: The statement is for labelled prism graphs with strict binary open-neighborhood synchronous majority, and only enumerates configurations fixed after one or two steps. A finite exact transfer-matrix certificate, independent vertex-level checks, and an all-length trace argument support the theorem; no independent audit or historical priority certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: No attraction-basin or transient-time enumeration is asserted.
General transfer methods predate the result; a complete text comparison with Jen (1988) was unavailable.
Fixed-point and two-cycle counts rely on the exact 256-state transfer construction and its characteristic-polynomial certificate.
Independent mathematical validation has not been performed.
title: A Lucas-number orbit census for synchronous majority on prism graphs
